summary: A hacker breached Muah.ai, an uncensored 'AI girlfriend' companion site, on September 17, 2024, describing it as built from 'duct-taped' open-source projects that were easy to exploit. The stolen database held about 1.9 million email addresses tied to users' prompts, many describing sexual fantasies and some involving child sexual abuse. The hacker, initially curious, gave the data to 404 Media after seeing the abuse content; it was added to Have I Been Pwned in October 2024. Muah.ai's administrator blamed an attack by competitors.
